retraction.reason: Retracted in M41b: LIVRE, the green and pro-European left party legalised in March 2014. It has held seats in the Assembly since 2019 and its cached leads name no election at all, only its founding principles; no record in this atlas names it either. It would be joined by a legislative election record that named it, exactly as Iniciativa Liberal was.
